summary: Columbia Banking System, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.37 per common share. The dividend is payable September 14, 2026 to shareholders of record as of August 28, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. No unusual terms, premium, or strategic implications are present. This is an ordinary capital return event consistent with the company's regular quarterly dividend practice. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
